description: Read the brand’s connected Pinterest AD account(s). Call with NO adAccountId to list the ad accounts shared with this profile — do this first to pick a target. Call WITH adAccountId to list that account’s campaigns (id, name, status, objective, budget, and Pinterest’s own summary status). Add campaignId to get that ONE campaign’s whole tree — its AD GROUPS and ADS with their ids, statuses and review status. That is the only way to enumerate them, and it matters: Pinterest has no delete, so an ad group you cannot see is one you cannot even archive. All money is in the AD ACCOUNT’S currency, which is not necessarily dollars. Pinterest’s own list default hides DRAFT and ARCHIVED objects; this asks for all four statuses so nothing is silently missing. Read-only, free. Needs Pinterest connected (Connectors > Pinterest) and the ad account ticked under Manage accounts (or call list_connector_accounts with provider pinterest_ads, then set_connector_accounts).

adAccountId.description: Pinterest ad account id — omit to list the ad accounts shared with this profile

campaignId.description: one campaign -> its ad groups and ads too (the only way to enumerate them)

statuses.description: filter by ACTIVE, PAUSED, ARCHIVED or DRAFT; omit to include all four

name: list_pinterest_ads_campaigns
title: List Pinterest ad accounts / campaigns
